description: Money-free world state after F0-A (engine 55e1522a: season ledger, failure ladder stages 1-2, winter ration x1.2, first-winter warning to the next harvest, historical-era readiness, save v12, bot barn_mill) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money and Building.upkeepUnpaid. F0-A changes the world by design (winter meals eat 1.2x, households track shortages, the state records seasons and eras, spec FP-*), so the C3 world of 9b5a18c no longer applies; this pins the F0-A world. The cache must still match the ledger on every tick.
